task.summary: Default task

Added support for meme damage values (Nice, Dank, Pi) in `AuraGCN_DamageText` and `AuraAbilitySystemBPLibrary`. Updated hit type serialization, `SetDamageText`, and gameplay effect context replication.

Cleaned up unused hit type encoding logic in `AuraAttributeSet`. Removed redundant comments and excessive whitespace for improved readability. Synced `.idea/workspace.xml` with updated file references.
Added `EAuraHitType` enum and helper methods to `AuraDamageTextComponent` for determining and displaying hit types, including new meme damage values (Nice, Dank, Pi).
Added `UAuraExecCalc_TestMemeNumbers` for testing hit types and meme damage values (Nice, Dank, Pi). Synced `.idea/workspace.xml` with new file references.
Added `GA_Aura_Spell_Fireball1` and `GE_Aura_Test_Damage1` assets. Updated `BP_Aura_DamageTextComponent` to support new effects.
Refactored `AuraGA_ProjectileSpell` to delegate damage handling to the new `AuraDamageGameplayAbility`. Added support for multiple damage types and updated related tags and blueprints.
Initialized default values for `Damage` and `DamageTypes` in `AuraDamageGameplayAbility`. Synced changes in `.idea/workspace.xml`.

Refactored `AuraGA_ProjectileSpell` to use scoped initialization and delegate damage type assignment to `AssignDamageTypesToSpec`. Enhanced `UAuraDamageGameplayAbility` with flexible damage type support.
Refactored `AuraExecCalc_Damage` to use scoped initialization, improved damage type handling, and added early-out for zero damage scenarios. Synced changes in `.idea/workspace.xml`.
Removed verbose logging from `AuraExecCalc_Damage`. Cleaned up `.idea/workspace.xml` and deleted unused asset references.
Removed `UAuraExecCalc_TestMemeNumbers` and associated header file as part of code cleanup.
Added `Resistance` gameplay tag namespace with sub-tags for `Fire`, `Lightning`, `Arcane`, and `Physical` resistances. Cleaned up unused references in `.idea/workspace.xml`.
Added resistance attributes (`Fire`, `Lightning`, `Arcane`, `Physical`) to `UAuraAttributeSet` with replication support and updated `.idea/workspace.xml`.
Added `GetResistanceAttributeForDamageType` utility to map damage types to resistance attributes. Updated `AuraExecCalc_Damage` to factor resistances into damage calculations.
Refactored `AuraExecCalc_Damage` to simplify resistance calculations using macro-based mapping. Updated logging format and removed redundant loops.
Added new gameplay tags for `Lightning`, `Arcane`, and `Physical` damage types under the `Aura.Damage` namespace.
Added `ResistanceAttributes` to `AuraCharacterClassInfo` with `.idea/workspace.xml` updates.
Added `ResistanceAttributes` application in `AuraAbilitySystemBPLibrary` and removed redundant macros from `AuraAttributeSet`. Updated `.idea/workspace.xml`.
Updated `.idea/workspace.xml` to remove stale changelist entries and synchronize task metadata.
Added `Resistance` gameplay tag support to attribute filtering in `AuraAttributeInfo` and updated `.idea/workspace.xml` with Resistance-related assets.
Renamed resistance gameplay tags for clarity and updated corresponding comments.
Updated `.idea/workspace.xml` to clean up stale changelist entries and synchronize with updated asset references.
Added randomized damage ranges for specific damage types in `AuraDamageGameplayAbility`. Refactored logic to support `TMap<FGameplayTag, FDamageRange>` for more flexibility.
Synced `.idea/workspace.xml` with updated file references and removed outdated entries for `GA_Aura_Spell_Fireball` assets.
Added `Destroy()` call to clean up `AuraGCN_ProjectileFlight` and synced `.idea/workspace.xml` with updated file references and new Fireball asset changes.
Adjusted `AuraGCN_ProjectileFlight` sound volume and updated `.DotSettings.user` with new file exclusions.
Delayed `AuraGCN_ProjectileFlight` destruction to next frame to prevent crashes and improved `IsValid` checks in `AuraProjectile`.
Cleaned up `.idea/workspace.xml` by removing outdated entries and added new file highlighting policies for `AuraAbilitySystemComponent`.
Remove redundant includes in `AuraAbilitySystemComponent.cpp` and update `.idea/workspace.xml` with new file highlighting policies
Adjust projectile impact sound pitch and flight sound volume. Update `.idea/workspace.xml` with new file tracking and highlighting policies.
Integrate AI controller and behavior tree support for enemy characters. Update build dependencies and configuration redirections.
Update `.idea/workspace.xml` to track new AI-related blueprints and behavior tree assets.
Refactor AI controller integration and initialize blackboard and behavior tree assets for enemy characters.

Add `AuraBTS_FindNearestPlayer` service node and integrate with AI behavior tree
- Added `UAuraBTS_FindNearestPlayer` class to locate the nearest player. - Updated `BT_Aura_Enemy_BehaviorTree` to include the new service node. - Reflected changes in `.idea/workspace.xml` for file tracking.
Update `.idea/workspace.xml` to reflect changes in AI behavior tree and service node files

Enhance `AuraBTS_FindNearestPlayer` functionality
- Added blackboard key selectors for nearest player, distance, and validity. - Implemented player detection and distance calculation in `TickNode`. - Updated `BT_Aura_Enemy_BehaviorTree` and `.idea/workspace.xml` for sync.
Refactor `AuraBTS_FindNearestPlayer` to iterate over player controllers for improved reliability and accuracy.

Add `MaxSearchDistance` to `AuraBTS_FindNearestPlayer` and refine player detection logic
- Introduced `MaxSearchDistance` property to limit detection radius. - Updated `TickNode` logic to include max distance checks. - Synced changes with `BT_Aura_Enemy_BehaviorTree` and `.idea/workspace.xml`.

Update `.idea/workspace.xml` and refine `AuraBTS_FindNearestPlayer` formatting
- Adjusted `.idea/workspace.xml` configurations. - Updated variable initialization and formatting in `AuraBTS_FindNearestPlayer`.

Update blackboard and behavior tree assets, refine `AuraBTS_FindNearestPlayer`, and adjust workspace configuration
- Added an additional blackboard key to `.uproject.DotSettings.user`. - Refined variable formatting in `AuraBTS_FindNearestPlayer`. - Updated `.idea/workspace.xml` to track changes in AI-related assets.
Enable `ControllerDesiredRotation` for enemy characters in `AuraEnemyCharacter.cpp` and update `.idea/workspace.xml` configuration.
Disable controller rotation axes and adjust movement rotation rate for `AuraEnemyCharacter`.
Randomize pitch variation for projectile flight and impact sounds.
Add `RandomPitchMultiplier` to manage pitch variation in flight and impact sounds
Update `GE_Aura_Hazards_Fire.uasset` asset
Rename `bDestroyOnEffectRemoval` to `bDestroyOnEffectApplication` and add `bApplyEffectsToEnemies` property in `AuraEffectActor`. Update redirects in `DefaultEngine.ini`.
Implement `IGameplayTagAssetInterface` in `AuraBaseCharacter` and add support for `CharacterTags` for better gameplay tag management. Introduce `Player` and `Enemy` entity tags in `AuraTags`.
Add `AffectedEntitiesTags` and `CanAffectActor` logic to `AuraEffectActor` for tag-based actor filtering.
Fix `CanAffectActor` method declaration in `AuraEffectActor` to remove redundant class qualifier.
